definition: Unique successful graph_add_concept births grouped by encountered source position into intervals ending at successful doc_append_thinking pauses, including nested batches and successful operations in partially failed batches. A concept added after the thought in the same batch remains with that pause. Excludes source passage nodes, document root, and thinking blocks. Includes concepts later archived; a revision is not a new concept.
word_count_method: Whitespace-separated words in the saved text. Main length and ratio metrics include the Core as stored. Source ratios use the whole encountered interval, including edition front matter/licence where present. Separate story-only counts clip at the recorded first-sentence and END-marker boundaries. Exact-Core-excluded counts are null if that exact prefix is absent. Quartiles use statistics.quantiles(method='inclusive').

result_without_source_content.hint: Use source_export to generate the final document with thinking traces.

interpretation: Descriptive baseline, not a node quota or a quality score. Compare distinct revisable ideas, grounding, previous-node use, uncertainty/disagreement and translation fidelity, accounting for source coverage and edition.
